description: An Australian rental housing conditions research infrastructure is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Emma Baker et al. Each year the proportion of Australians who rent their home increases and, for the first time in generations, there are now as many renters as outright homeowners. Researchers and policy makers, however, know very little about housing conditions within Australia’s rental housing sector due to a lack of systematic, reliable data. Coverage: national (AU); published in 2022. Formats: ZIP, PDF, CSV. The data are held in ADA Dataverse and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 2356856. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is Custom terms specific to this dataset, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
